decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher with a dedicated product page and a strong fit to the core postpress range, it remains a sensible portfolio product even after last year's pruning.

The UV spot varnishing system is farther from the historic core and therefore somewhat more exposed after resources were redirected in 2024, but its flagship positioning and fit with print enhancement still argue for continued support.
The sheet preparation module directly supports the firm's automation-oriented finishing workflow and is unlikely to be removed unless the firm makes another sharp simplification of the range.
A hybrid saddle stitcher sits firmly within the company's booklet-making and binding competence, so in a growing market it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
The folding add-on unit was marketed less prominently than the main machines, but its proven customer use and modular complement to existing systems make retention the more probable choice.
